title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: graph connector prompts in the Prompt Gallery for Copilot Chat
summary: Hold: the risk section and licensing checklist say federated connectors require the Copilot add-on without preserving Microsoft's Microsoft 365 E7 alternative. The roadmap details are accurate, but the assertion that the change introduces no new data path goes beyond the published description.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; summary; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Licensing is unknown because Microsoft publishes no licence specific to graph connector prompts in Prompt Gallery.
claims.quote: Copilot Chat (Basic) is the standalone baseline experience included with eligible Microsoft 365 licenses. Searched: Copilot Prompt Gallery license requirements Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat connector suggested prompts; read Prompt Gallery and connector prerequisites, with no prompt-specific entitlement.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to included for this new gallery option inside Copilot Chat. Replace the first licensing note and the summary's 'no ... licence' wording with: 'Copilot Chat is included with eligible Microsoft 365 licences; licensing specific to these new prompts is not yet published.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/plan/copilot-overview. Keep the separately documented connector licensing qualification.
